title: The Way We Are (bc30)
synopsis: Cheung Ka-on lives with his mother in Tin Shui Wai. Growing up in a single-parent family, he and his mother hold dear to each other. He is obedient to his mother, yet his grades aren’t outstanding, living an ordinary life. Meanwhile, although Mrs. Cheung is a single mother, she never complains but works hard to raise her son. When she was young, she used her hard-earned money to send her two younger brothers to study abroad. Although she didn't have much contact with her brothers, they shared a deep bond……

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 張家安，一個與母親住在天水圍的應屆會考生，他在一個單親家庭長大，與母親一起相依為命，比較聽從母親的話，成績也不算優秀但為人很普通。 而張母雖然是單親母親，但從不自怨自艾，而是努力將兒子養大，並積極工作——她在一家超級市場的生果檔當售貨員，敬業樂業。在她年少時她把努力工作賺來的錢供兩個弟弟到國外讀書，而與弟弟們之間雖然平時很少來往，但感情深厚......
